payload.title: auth keeps two disjoint records of who manages a module, tenant_modules.managerId (written only by Assign/Remove Manager) and user_module_assignments.isPrimaryManager (written only by the member assignment flow), and no access decision reads managerId, so the admin UI shows a manager that grants nothing
evidence: apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/entities/tenant-module.entity.ts:102-108 (managerId: the user responsible for managing this module)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/authentication/entities/user-module-assignment.entity.ts:62-68 (isPrimaryManager: the primary manager for this module)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:578-586 (Assign Manager writes managerId and promotes users.role, never isPrimaryManager)
apps/auth-service/src/modules/tenant/services/tenant.service.ts:609 (Remove Manager clears managerId only; the role and isPrimaryManager stay)
web/modules/tenant-admin/src/graphql/module-queries.ts:44 (admin UI reads managerId as the module manager)
payload.rule_violated: Repo single-source-of-truth rule and plan section 2: module authority is one per-module grant carried in moduleAccess.
payload.notes: Program module-boundaries, package PKG-40, release R13.
